disclaimer: Educational, fictionalized, dimensionless model. Not a reactor simulator. Not suitable for engineering or safety decisions.
subject_model: Each vector declares a subject. Exposed result values: run -> {params, final:{freeNeutrons,absorbedNeutrons,escapedNeutrons,reactionEvents,cumulativeEnergyUnits}, snapshots:[{step,freeNeutrons,absorbedNeutrons,escapedNeutrons,reactionEvents,cumulativeEnergyUnits}], stopReason}; multi -> {r1..rn} one per seed; pair_same -> {a,b}; aggregate_pair -> {a,b, seeds}; counterfactual -> {original, counterfactual, changedVariable}; schema -> {valid, error}. Operators: equals, not_equals, gte, lte, gt, lt, in_range, all_fields_gte_zero, identical_to, differs_from, length_lte, one_of, all_of.

operators.all_fields_gte_zero: every numeric field of the target object is >= 0
operators.identical_to: target object deep-equals the object at the reference path
operators.differs_from: target object deep-differs from the object at the reference path
operators.one_of: extracted value is one of the listed values
operators.all_of: every listed path satisfies the nested assertion

calibration_note: Vectors flagged calibration_required=true are stochastic: seed values may need to be adjusted once on the real engine so the relational assertion holds robustly. The invariant they guard is mandatory; the specific seeds are not. Vectors without the flag must hold for any seed.

vectors.title: Zero-neutron no-reaction case
vectors.notes: Engine must be called directly with startingNeutrons=0 (UI slider min is 1).

vectors.title: Zero-neutron no-reaction case across multiple seeds
vectors.notes: Zero-population behavior must be seed-independent.

vectors.title: Seed reproducibility: identical parameters + seed yield identical full history
vectors.notes: Compare every snapshot, not just final values.

vectors.title: Seed variation produces different outcomes
vectors.notes: Stochastic: if seeds 42/43 coincide, try consecutive seeds until divergence. Guards against a hidden global RNG ignoring the seed.

vectors.title: Parameter lower bounds are clamped
vectors.notes: Engine-level clampParameters must keep every value in the configured safe range (experiments.ts:188-212).

vectors.title: Parameter upper bounds are clamped
vectors.notes: Also guards against CPU-burning runs from hostile inputs.

vectors.title: Nonnegative state across many seeds and full duration
vectors.notes: Check every snapshot, not only the final one. freeNeutrons must also be integer.

vectors.title: Step termination: run ends at the configured step cap
vectors.notes: If stopReason is 'completed', the last snapshot step must equal durationSteps.

vectors.title: Population termination: hard cap is never exceeded
vectors.notes: Expect max_population with the ceiling snapshot exactly 500 for this configuration; calibrate seed if it does not blow up.

vectors.title: Absorption comparison: more absorber never increases propagation
vectors.notes: Single-seed comparisons can invert due to random-stream re-consumption; aggregate over seeds. Same seeds applied to both configurations.

vectors.title: Low-absorption comparison: lower absorption permits greater propagation
vectors.notes: The 'withdraw and it takes off' lesson must hold on average.

vectors.title: Starting population alters early behavior but not the propagation rule
vectors.notes: Aggregate only: per-seed monotonicity is not guaranteed because random consumption differs. Rule constants (escape/fission/absorption) must be identical in both runs.

vectors.title: Repeated trials reveal distributions, not one guaranteed outcome
vectors.notes: Guard: at least two distinct final populations across 25 seeds, proving randomness is real and visible. Calibrate the parameter point so this holds comfortably.

vectors.title: Counterfactual changes exactly one variable and locks seed and duration
vectors.notes: Counterfactual variables are allowlisted; seed and durationSteps are rejected as changeable variables (counterfactual.ts:15-20).

vectors.title: Counterfactual original remains immutable
vectors.notes: original_reference = an independent run of the original parameters performed before the counterfactual. The original trial object must not be mutated (counterfactual.ts:22-31, 58).

vectors.title: Counterfactual keeps the same randomness stream
vectors.notes: Same seed means any outcome difference is attributable to the single changed variable. This is the causal claim of the whole product.

vectors.title: Representation independence: switching views never re-simulates

subject.setup: Run one trial. Record trial id and snapshots. Switch representations in order: animation, graph, equation, causal, plain_language. Switch back to animation.
steps: Run trial with defaults and seed 42

vectors.notes: Views render recorded snapshots only; no view may trigger runSimulation. Inspect network/console for re-runs.

vectors.title: Animation speed independence: outcome identical at any speed

subject.setup: Run one trial at default speed (1x). Record final values. Set animation speed to 0.25x, replay. Set to 2x, replay.
steps: Set animationSpeed 0.25, replay the same trial
Set animationSpeed 2, replay the same trial

vectors.notes: Speed changes frame delay only (simulation-canvas.tsx:33-37); the recorded trial is unchanged.

vectors.title: Reduced-motion independence: same science, static presentation

subject.setup: Run one trial with motion enabled. Record final values. Enable reduced motion, run an identical trial (same params + seed). Compare.
steps: Enable reduced motion in accessibility settings

vectors.notes: Reduced motion renders static frames with '!' markers (simulation-canvas.tsx:323-335); data must be identical to the motion run.

vectors.title: Reset behavior: clear session restores defaults and replay reproduces

subject.setup: Run a trial, change variables, then clear session via Research mode. Verify defaults restored. Run again with identical params + seed and compare snapshots.
steps: Run trial with defaults seed 42, record snapshots
Verify controls show defaults and no trial remains
Run defaults seed 42 again, compare with first run

vectors.notes: Reset is also the only current path to a second primary run (single-run session constraint).

vectors.title: Pause behavior: playback halts and resumes without altering the trial

subject.setup: Start playback. Pause. Wait 1 second; verify current step does not advance. Resume; verify it advances from the paused step.

vectors.notes: Pause is presentation-only; the recorded trial never changes.

vectors.title: Step-forward behavior: single-step advances exactly one step

subject.setup: Pause playback at step k. Press step-forward three times; record steps. Press step-back twice; record.
steps: Run trial, pause at step k

vectors.notes: Guards the reduced-motion / stepwise-learning path.

vectors.title: Overflow prevention: finite values, bounded counters at max settings
vectors.notes: Also asserts the abstract-unit arithmetic: cumulativeEnergyUnits = reactionEvents x ENERGY_PER_REACTION (2). No NaN/Infinity may appear.

vectors.title: Corrupt parameter rejection: NaN, Infinity, and non-numbers are rejected
vectors.notes: zod schema (experiments.ts:48-55) must reject NaN/Infinity/null/objects. KNOWN GAP: the engine's clampParameters does not itself guard NaN (Math.min/max pass NaN through) — the schema is the boundary. If any path bypasses the schema, NaN could propagate into snapshots. Add Number.isFinite guard in clampParameter (S1, ~0.5h).

vectors.title: Large trial safety: burst of max-size runs stays bounded and responsive

subject.setup: Run 50 trials of the max-duration explosive configuration in a loop (via clear-session between runs or engine loop). Verify no error, bounded snapshots, bounded population, and the UI remains responsive.
steps: Execute 50 runs of params: absorber 0.2, start 10, density 1, absorption 0.01, duration 120, varying seeds
Assert every run completed with a stop reason
Assert page stays interactive (no frozen main thread)

vectors.notes: Guards the demo risk of a learner (or judge) mashing Run. localStorage growth is bounded by evidence size per trial; watch quota on repeated exports.

vectors.title: Replay consistency: identical evidence yields identical replay and proposals

subject.setup: Open Adaptation Replay twice from the same session state; the rendered journey must be identical. Call the adaptation provider twice with the same input; the proposal types and order must be identical.
steps: Open Adaptation Replay, record rendered steps
Call provider.propose(sameInput) twice, compare rule selections

vectors.notes: Determinism of the adaptation layer is part of the scientific honesty story (deterministic-provider.ts). Proposal UUIDs may vary; rule selection must not.
